description.value:
Trigger A creature enters the chamber

Effect The spirits whisper in a chorus of sibilant voices. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(3d12+18)[mental]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[will|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] save. A creature that doesn't understand Sakvroth gains a +4 circumstance bonus to their save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

details.description: The spirits of the dead entice visitors with forbidden knowledge.
details.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:40] or @Check[religion|dc:40] (expert) to ward off the spirits' influence, @Check[intimidation|dc:42] (trained) to silence the whispers. A PC who brandishes the gaze of eternity gains a +2 item bonus to their checks. Three successes total are required to disable the haunt.
details.reset: The hazard deactivates after 1 minute or after the spirits have answered three questions, whichever comes first. It resets after 24 hours.
details.routine: (1 action) The spirits peer into the minds of up to three creatures in the area. Each creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save. On a failure, the target must choose to either divulge a closely guarded secret or take @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]|options:area-damage] damage. On a critical success, the target can ask the haunt a question, which the spirits answer truthfully to the best of their ability.
